transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Just avoid heavy work or lifting for a month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you! I was also wondering, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running low, your GP should be able to provide more. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Okay, that's good to know. I'm experiencing a lot of sensitivity to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended: Mild light sensitivity can be normal while the eye adjusts to the new lens. If it’s just brighter than usual, wearing sunglasses outside is recommended. But significant pain in bright light, or severe light sensitivity, is not normal, especially if the eye is red and painful, and we may need to assess this further. Do you have any other questions?
transcript.delivered: Mild light sensitivity can be normal while the eye adjusts to the new lens.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It’s common for vision to not be completely clear in the first week after your operation. It should improve quickly and settle down over time. If it is still blurry, or getting worse, we may need to check it. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I don't have any more questions. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they have. Thank you so much!

verdict.label: fail
